proposals.evidence: Turner bhaṅga explicitly gives Bengali bhāṅā to be broken, Oriya bhāṅgibā to break and Gujarati bhā̃gũ broken to pieces. These eastern and western broken-state forms are compared with that nasal bhaṅg- family, with ordinary past/stative suffixes and local reductions preserved. They are kept distinct from the unnasalized bhagna branch of bhajyate.
